sloka: निपेतुः च नराः सर्वे तेन शब्देन मोहिताः ।व्रजयित्वा मुनि वरम् राजानम् तौ च राघवौ ॥१-६७-१९॥
transliteration: nipetuḥ ca narāḥ sarve tena śabdena mohitāḥ ।vrajayitvā muni varam rājānam tau ca rāghavau ॥1-67-19॥

translations.english: On hearing the sound, except Janaka, Viswamitra and the two raghavas (Rama and Lakshmana) the rest of the people around fell down and fainted.
